text:
rebecca_cust: Hi team — Fjord Health pilot goes live tomorrow morning. Can we get a phased egress allowlist + temporary rate bump for EU + US regions for the initial demo window? Expecting bursty load between 06:00-12:00 UTC. IPs to allow: 34.208.12.0/24, 34.208.13.0/24. Target qps bump from 120 -> 320 for ~6 hours. Also would like edge peering enabled to eu-west-1 for lower latency. Please confirm timelines thanks.

elaine_cs: Thanks Rebecca — adding SRE and Network. Can you confirm the customer account ID and project name (so we attach the changes to the right billing/retention)?

rebecca_cust: Account: fjord-prod-001; project: pilot-fjord. Demo traffic is short bursts (approx 30s spikes). Renewal in ~90 days so need solid demo telemetry.

jamie_network: Ack. I'm on it. Quick question: do they need an IP allowlist for inbound traffic to our endpoints (from their proxies) or for outbound egress? And where is TLS terminated — at our edge or theirs?

rebecca_cust: Inbound to our hosted endpoints from their proxies. TLS termination is at our edge (standard).

jamie_network: Got it. I'll open a temporary CIDR allowlist entry and request peering. Proposed change summary: +200 qps per region, 6h window, allowlist the two CIDRs, enable eu-west-1 peering. Patching firewall rules now. Config snippet: ```json
{ "customer": "fjord-prod-001", "allowlist": ["34.208.12.0/24","34.208.13.0/24"], "regions": ["eu-west-1","us-east-1"], "rate_limit": {"old_qps":120,"new_qps":320,"window_seconds":21600} }
```

mohit_eng: I'll provision a dedicated burst token bucket for pilot-fjord on Dedicated pool "burst-pool-2" and lock margins so noisy-neighbor risk is mitigated. ETA ~20m for rollout.

priya_oncall: Oncall note: I'll monitor 429s & error rates. Adding SLI: if 429 rate >5% sustained for 5m -> automatic rollback and pager. Also bump trace sampling to 100% for pilot-fjord during the window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: firewall-rule-update requested by jamie_network for fjord-prod-001. Change ID: FR-2103-89. Scheduled immediate.

jamie_network: FR applied on our side. Peering request sent to cloud provider for eu-west-1 (typically 10-15m). Will post updates here.

rebecca_cust: Thanks — small additional ask: can we keep request logs for 30 days for this pilot so the customer can capture perf metrics for renewal?

elaine_cs: We can enable extended logs under retention package "pilot-30d". I'll attach the billing note and enable the retention for fjord-prod-001.

mohit_eng: Burst pool provisioning completed. Quick smoke shows capacity headroom and no negative impact to other tenants in the pool.

priya_oncall: Alert rule created: fjord-prod-001_429_policy. Notifications -> #eng-oncall and paging to oncall@sre if triggered. I'll keep an eye on traces.

rebecca_cust: Perfect — we'll kick the demo off at ~06:10 UTC and I'll post realtime notes here if anything weird shows up.

jamie_network: :thumbsup: Good luck — ping in this thread if you need to extend the window or add more CIDRs.
